items.text: on the Play ring, back and next sit at the bottom, nearest the bar (back on the left, next on the right); volume takes the top, dice moves to the right
in the dice shelf, SEC, BEAT and BAR are set like PAIR beside them, no longer in large type

a third ring, Sound: master, wet and react, the mixer's levels (beat, water, bytes; the mic and its loop while the mic is on), tap tempo (the ring stays open while you tap) and mute. Switch to it from the ring's name
a gear that opens a drawer makes it shine: a light runs round its edge, like the Founders Club call
a double-tap never zooms the page any more, and a zoom that slips in goes back by itself
a long press no longer highlights the interface's words like a web page (fields you type into still can)
tapping away from the ring folds it home one petal at a time, and its name becomes a small circle that sinks into the middle
the ring's petals fold away instead of blinking out (when you tap away, and when you choose one)
a quick double-tap opens the ring more reliably: taps can be a little further apart and a little faster
a lit tile in the Tools shelf (dots, arrows, travel…) wears only the soft rectangle, without the old round disc on top
while a video or GIF records, its small window above the bar stays in one place instead of jumping up and down
when a shelf's door or the ring's panel dot opens a panel or the index, its edge glows blue twice, so you see where you went
the ring's mark sits beside the bug button, with the Steer it path's dot: tap it for the ring and how to open it yourself. Once you have opened the ring twice on your own, it goes
